name: Heavy Greater Thunderstone
primary:
A projectile flies in an arc where you look and strikes the first target. Effects:
• Damage 1.25 ❤ lightning + 3.5 ❤ earth (lightning ×2 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Charge 35: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 4 targets in a row, jumps up to 4 blocks, 1.25 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Knockback
• Breaks up to 9 blocks within 1.5 blocks (twice as many if brittle)
self_description:
On you:
• Damage 1.25 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 35: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Stone skin (Resistance III) for 11 s
• Slowness III for 8.5 s
